answer: Faking a thousand agents means funding a thousand fading embers, so a sybil voyage across the network costs far more than honest participation, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Sybil resistance can bind identity to a costly, decaying proof-of-work stake: each agent must burn compute to mint an ember token that fades over epochs, and every new identity triggers a ripple of escalating burn requirements. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
